{{Quote|My ''starfighter''&mdash;it's out of control! I'm trying to chart the trajectory&mdash;''No!'' A collision with the moon will ignite the ore! The explosion will destroy it and endanger Themis&mdash;!|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] both undertook a '''mission''' to [[Themis]] for the same reason: to gain the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] allegiance in the midst of the [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] conflict.
